## Description

Sign modal: "Sign note for {name}? MRN · DOB · encounter id. I have reviewed every section … read-only after signing. Prescriptions and orders are authorised separately." CTA "Sign as Dr. {name}" requires passkey/MFA step-up. Signed NOTE_VERSION v1 is stored in a ledger table with document hash; banner "SIGNED v1 · read-only" and signer line with licence number and time.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Only a doctor with a verified licence and care relationship can sign; step-up authentication is required within the last 5 minutes.
- [ ] **AC2.** After signing, the note body cannot be modified through any API; an automated test attempts direct API and repository updates and both fail (exit gate 3).
- [ ] **AC3.** The stored document hash verifies against the rendered content; ledger verification passes.
- [ ] **AC4.** Signing writes NoteSigned.v1 (no PHI) and an audit event; Today removes it from pending notes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
